description: This file contains mock implementations and utility functions for testing authentication-related features, including mocks for Prisma, Logger, LicenseKey, DeploymentRepository, UserRepository, Avatar URL, Stringify, and Token, as well as mock data creators for User and Token.

classes.name: MockUserRepository
classes.description: Mock implementation of UserRepository with method to enrich user profile.

methods.name: resetPrismaMock
methods.description: Resets the Prisma mock to its initial state.

methods.name: createLoggerMock
methods.description: Creates a mock logger with warn, error, and debug functions.

methods.name: createLicenseKeyMock
methods.description: Mocks the LicenseKeySingleton with getInstance method.

methods.name: createUserRepositoryMock
methods.description: Mocks the UserRepository class with enrichUserWithTheProfile method.

methods.name: createMockUser
methods.description: Creates a mock User object with default or overridden properties.

methods.name: createMockToken
methods.description: Creates a mock JWT token with default or overridden properties.
